agent_key.description: Platform identifier of the stored agent definition (echoed into the run prompt label).

label.description: Human-readable name of the agent, e.g. 'Instagram Agent'.

entry_skill_dir.description: Repo-relative directory of the entry skill (must contain SKILL.md). Restricted to products/, skills/, clients/ subtrees; no traversal.

skill_roots.description: Additional repo-relative skill roots (vendor packs) linked into the shim.

include_client_skills.description: Also link every skill under clients/<slug>/skills/.

instructions.description: The stored agent system-prompt text appended after the common preamble. Kept small: the whole JobSpec travels as one env var (Cloud Run override limit).

prompt.description: The user's request for this run, e.g. 'create 3 instagram posts about the new offer'.

notes.description: Optional extra notes for the agent.

step_models.description: Optional per-step model override, keyed by the named subagent identifier the skill's steps delegate to via the Task tool. Only takes effect when the skill's steps are structured as named subagent delegations matching these keys.

model.description: Optional whole-run model override, replacing the custom task type's default (claude-opus-4-8). Set this when a skill's own catalog entry recommends a cheaper tier — e.g. a linear, non-subagent skill where step_models has no delegation point to attach to.
